audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 reads Fiora while whys[1] says 'Level 2 stays a skill lane', and Levels 4-5 reads Skill while whys[3] says 'You take levels 4-5'. The packet levelChart reads Skill / Skill / Fiora / Zaahen / Skill / Fiora / Fiora, and the already-audited mirror set win[1] to Skill and win[3] to Zaahen as one group.
audit.why: Three sources agree against the two badges, and the mirror has already moved — leaving these rows would put the directions in conflict.
audit.corrected: Level 2 flipped to Skill and Levels 4-5 to Zaahen as matched full+content pairs, with the 4-5 rating raised from 4/10 to 6/10 so it reads as a Zaahen window rather than a losing one.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riposte is the tracked cooldown in roughly twenty fields and its length is never given, so 'commit when Riposte is down' is untimed advice.
audit.why: Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16s — 20s at rank 3, one of the longest defensive cooldowns in the lane. Lunge is 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s and Grand Challenge 110/90/70s.
audit.corrected: 20s written into breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[0].text and late; Lunge's 9.5s into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Riposte stun is written as unconditional — 'Parries + stuns your combo', 'she can W your Q Darkin Glaive or E Golden Onslaught to stun you'. Riot's text is explicit: the stab SLOWS the first champion hit, and only STUNS if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with it. Separately, 'E true damage' appears twice; Bladework has no true damage (it is attack speed, a slow, then a crit) — the true damage belongs to her Vitals. And Lunge applying on-hit effects is never mentioned.
audit.why: This is the whole matchup. Zaahen's two immobilising abilities are the Q recast knock-up and the W pull — those are the only things that arm her stun. Open with plain damage and Riposte gives her a slow, not a stun; open with the knock-up and you hand her the 20-second window she wants. The current text tells the player his dash can be parried into a stun, which sends him into the wrong fear.
audit.corrected: The immobilise condition stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, spikes[0].text and wants.foe[0]; true damage re-attributed to Vitals in spikes[2].text and late; Lunge's on-hit application added to breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[2].text.

audit.why: Anti-heal is already core in report[8].t and breakdown.late, correct against Duelist's Dance and Grand Challenge. The R heal also reaches her ALLIES, which is now stated in late.
audit.corrected: Ally heal added to late; no item change.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries + stuns your combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Fiora Riposte (20s at rank 3): it only stuns if it blocks an immobilise, so never open with your knock-up or pull. - Lunge (9.5s): it applies on-hit items. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Parries + stuns your combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It stuns only if it blocks your knock-up. Bait it before you commit.

edits.before: Track Fiora's Riposte: Parries + stuns your combo. Bait it. When it is down — Combo + R her.
edits.after: Riposte only stuns when it parries an immobilise — lead with autos, never your pull.

edits.before: At level 3 Fiora's E Bladework double-attack plus W Riposte parry make her a nightmare to trade into — she can W your Q Darkin Glaive or E Golden Onslaught to stun you, so hold your key ability until her Riposte is down, then punish at levels 4-5 when your cooldowns realign.
edits.after: At level 3 Fiora's E Bladework double-attack plus W Riposte parry make her a nightmare to trade into — Riposte only stuns if it blocks an immobilise, so open with plain damage and keep the Q recast knock-up back until her 20-second parry is spent.

edits.before: With her first item Fiora's Q Lunge mobility and E true-damage let her chase Vitals faster than you can peel; the parry uptime and heal outscale your sustained trade.
edits.after: With her first item Fiora's Q Lunge carries her on-hit items and her Vitals do the true damage; the parry uptime and R heal outscale your sustained trade.

edits.before: With items Fiora takes over — her Q Lunge mobility, E true damage, and R Grand Challenge heal let her chase your Vitals and negate your engage with a well-timed parry, so only commit when her Riposte is spent.
edits.after: With items Fiora takes over — her Q Lunge applies on-hit items, her Vitals deal the true damage, and R Grand Challenge heals her and her allies, so only commit when her 20-second Riposte is spent.

edits.before: Parry your engage ability with W Riposte for the stun
edits.after: Parrying your knock-up with W Riposte for the stun

notes: The unconditional-stun claim was the most damaging error in this matchup: it made Zaahen's dash look like the parry bait when the real trigger is his knock-up and his pull. Everything about Riposte here now follows Riot's own wording. The 'E true damage' error appeared twice and is re-attributed to her Vitals.
